snippet.title: Alien Attack gameplay MS-DOS
snippet.description:
In Alien Attack, you control a ship that moves left and right. Shoot down the descending aliens before they reach Earth.

Alien Attack was released as a MS-DOS game in 1993 by Martin Software Productions. Inspired by Space Invaders, Galaga, and similar space shooters, it is an ASCII text game. This makes the graphics look extremely simple. The aliens come down in sets of three and good timing is needed to anticipate their movements so you can shoot them down. A novel feature is that you can select the starting speed from 0 to 9. The speed increases as you progress through the game. The typical controls are the keyboard arrow buttons (movement) and space bar (shoot).

There is a List of Champions to keep track of high scores.
